bio: Warren House is a magnificent Victorian house that sits in a peaceful and secluded area of the exclusive Coombe Estate in Surrey, close to the historic town of Kingston upon Thames and Richmond Park.  Enjoy Afternoon Tea in the Persian Restaurant or on the terrace, overlooking five acres of peaceful landscaped gardens.  The Afternoon Tea menu includes a variety of teas and herbal infusions, a delicious array of mouth-watering finger sandwiches, scones with home-made jams, along with an assortment of cakes and sweet delicacies inspired by season.  Please note that a member of staff from Warren House will be phoning you to confirm your booking prior to your arrival and will be asking for a pre-payment of your Afternoon Tea. Please note Warren House has a 72 hour cancellation policy.  Please let the venue know if you have any special requests or dietary requirements.
